changelog:
qwencloud-video-generation 0.2.1

- Added explicit guidance to use qwencloud-model-selector skill or QwenCloud CLI for real-time model information.
- Noted that the CLI requires authentication and directed users to qwencloud-usage for login instructions.
- Clarified the "point-in-time snapshot" limitation of the listed models and emphasized checking the official QwenCloud model list.
- No core functionality or script changes; documentation and instructions improved for dynamic model access.
summary: [QwenCloud] Generate videos using Wan models. Supports text-to-video, image-to-video, first+last frame, reference-based role-play, and video editing (VACE)....
